profile.name: Pawan Shrestha
profile.headline: Computer Engineering Graduate | AI & Data Science Enthusiast
profile.shortBio: Recently graduated from Nepal Engineering College with a Bachelor's in Computer Engineering. Passionate about building intelligent systems with Python, machine learning, and data-driven software.
profile.bio: I'm Pawan Shrestha, a Computer Engineering graduate from Nepal Engineering College. I love exploring technology and solving problems through code. My interests include Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, and Software Development. I enjoy working on projects that help me learn new skills and create useful solutions. I am eager to begin my professional journey and contribute to innovative and impactful projects. Currently seeking opportunities in Software Engineering, AI/ML, and Data Science to grow my skills and gain industry experience.
profile.availability: Open to junior software, AI, and data science opportunities

settings.metaDescription: Portfolio of Pawan Shrestha, a computer engineering graduate specializing in AI, machine learning, Python, and data science.

projects.title: Melomatch
projects.summary: Song sharing Platform for music lovers
projects.description: This Project is a dedicated platform to the music lovers where they can post, share their taste on music to strangers. Users can interact with each other. This project uses React for frontend, Node for Backend and MongoDB for database

projects.title: Urban Sprawl Prediction
projects.summary: An ML model which predicts the urban expansion in major cities of Nepal.
projects.description:
Built U-Net/ConvLSTM model achieving 85% accuracy on satellite image classification across 3 cities; predicted urban sprawl with
78% precision for 2030 forecasts. Implemented data preprocessing pipeline using pandas and scikit-learn. Generated predictive
visualizations for urban expansion patterns until 2030

projects.title: CleanCity
projects.summary: A web app that helps people report city problems like garbage, potholes, and drainage issues using photos and location.
projects.description: CleanCity allows users to upload photos of public issues with their location. The app uses AI to identify the problem and helps city officials track, manage, and resolve complaints through an admin dashboard.
